messages:
Nia (People Ops): Quick thread: new hire Mateo Ruiz (remote, OR) has an alias listed on the background check. Vendor flagged for identity confirmation. Mateo's start is Monday and he prefers Day 0 remote onboarding at 9am. Can we reconcile before then?
Samira (Recruiter): Mateo says the alias is a maiden/previous legal name used until 2016. He uploaded a deed and a name-change affidavit to the secure portal at 14:05.
bg-check-bot: Background check status: REVIEW_REQUIRED - ALIAS_NAME_MATCH. Report link: https://bg.example.com/reports/MR-99102
Leah (Security): We need vendor adjudication notes and copies of name-change docs. If the affidavit lines up with DOB/SSN, we'll clear. Until then, restrict access.
Carlos (Hiring Manager): He needs a laptop and to attend orientation. Can we issue limited access so he can attend Day 0?
Nia (People Ops): Yes, we can do provisional onboarding: loaner laptop, limited SSO, no AWS or prod creds. IT will add a provisional flag. Provide start materials and manager intro only.
IT-provision-bot: Provision queued: loaner-laptop + provisional-sso for Mateo Ruiz. Ticket: PROV-1899. ETA 1 business day.
Samira (Recruiter): Mateo also asked about remote I-9 options. He's willing to use a notary. I sent him the authorized-agent template and a quick script he can show the notary.
Nia (People Ops): Good. Please ensure the notary attaches their ID and signs Section 3. Upload scanned I-9 to Workday. Also upload the name-change docs to the vendor intake.
Leah (Security): Once vendor adjudicates and we have the affidavit + ID match, I'll clear dev-staging access. Send me the adjudication note DM.
Samira (Recruiter): Vendor acknowledged receipt of docs at 16:22 and expects adjudication within 24-48h. Mateo confirmed he can start Day 0 for orientation without prod access.
Nia (People Ops): Ok filing this for audit and setting benefits hold until SSN/name fully verified. Mateo invited to remote orientation 9am Monday (calendar invite sent). We'll update when adjudication completes. :white_check_mark:
bg-check-bot: Background check status updated: AWAITING_VENDOR_ADJUDICATION (2025-12-02 16:22)
